mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_status_alert (animal_cage_id, status_code, started_at, fired_at, threshold_days, action, state, estimated, active_key) VALUES (#{animalCageId}, #{statusCode}, #{startedAt}, #{firedAt}, #{thresholdDays}, #{action}, #{state}, #{estimated}, #{activeKey})
mapper.update: UPDATE cage_status_alert SET state = 'ACTIVE', fired_at = #{firedAt}, threshold_days = #{thresholdDays}, action = #{action}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'PENDING'
UPDATE cage_status_alert SET state = 'CLEARED', cleared_at = #{clearedAt}, active_key = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND state != 'CLEARED'
UPDATE cage_status_alert SET violation_id = #{violationId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND violation_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, animal_cage_id AS animalCageId, status_code AS statusCode, state AS state, started_at AS startedAt FROM cage_status_alert WHERE state != 'CLEARED'
